title: Satisfying Gameplay
description: Creating a Minecraft that simply is just better than vanilla. Tons of quality of life improvements over the many performance mods added to ensure stutter-free gameplay. Of course, remove those you don't like. It's your world after all :)
body:
# Satisfying Gameplay

*A handpicked, compatibility-tested setup for the way Minecraft should look and feel.*

This modpack is the exact setup from the video — every mod and resource pack I use when starting a new world. Not just a shader. Not just a performance boost. All of it: the sounds, the animations, the particles, the connected textures, the distant horizons — working together, tested for compatibility.

If you've ever wanted Minecraft to feel like a game that came out this decade, this is the setup.

**DISCLAIMER - I DO NOT OWN ANY OF THESE MODS AND RESOURCE PACKS.**

Modpack made by _Weaver_.
Check out my channel here -> [YT Channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5XXjKO88JedHA8xC03NiNA)

---

## Performance

- **Sodium** — rendering engine replacement, massive FPS gains
- **Lithium** — server-side optimisations: AI, physics, chunk loading
- **Entity Culling** — stops rendering entities you can't see
- **Immediately Fast** — speeds up text and UI rendering
- **Noisium Forked** — faster world generation and chunk loading
- **Iris Shaders** — shader support without Optifine
- **Mod Menu** — in-game mod list
- **Resourcify** — browse and install resource packs in-game

---

## Visuals

- **Photon / Complementary Shaders** — two great options; Complementary for warmth, Photon for drama. Pick one.
- **Distant Horizons** — LOD rendering far beyond your normal render distance. The horizon actually looks like a horizon.
- **Hold My Items** — better offhand item visibility
- **Swinging Lanterns** — placed lanterns actually swing

---

## Atmosphere & sound

- **Atmosphera** — environmental audio: wind, cave reverb, birdsong
- **Sounds** — additional ambient sound events
- **The Immersive Music Mod** — biome-specific music that actually fits
- **Gentler Weather Sounds** `[RP]` — smoother rain audio transitions
- **Drip Sounds** — water dripping in caves
- **Make Bubbles Pop** — bubble column sounds
- **Presence Footsteps** — surface-specific footstep audio
- **Subtle Effects** — screen vignette and tilt when hurt or low on health
- **Visuality** — extra particle details throughout the world
- **Footprint Particle** — footprints in snow and soft ground
- **Particle Effects** — enhanced environmental particles
- **Particle Interactions** — particles that react to what you're doing

---

## Textures & animations

- **Continuity** — enables connected textures (required for the RPs below)
- **Connected Paths** `[RP]` — seamlessly tiling dirt paths
- **Connected Bricks & Rocks** `[RP]` — connected stone and brick surfaces
- **3D Crops Revamped** `[RP]` — actual geometry on crops instead of flat sprites
- **Spring Flowers** `[RP]` — richer, more varied flower textures
- **Re-covered Enchantment Books** `[RP]` — unique texture per enchantment
- **Enchanted Icons** `[RP]` — glyphs on items showing active enchantments
- **Fresh Animations** `[RP]` — new animation rigs for all vanilla mobs
- **GEO** `[RP]` — added geometric detail to blocks and structures
- **Appleskins** — shows hunger and saturation values on food items
- **Theone's Eating Animation Pack** `[RP]` — first-person eating animation

---

## UI & camera

- **Better Inventory** — improved inventory UI
- **Mouse Tweaks** — drag-fill slots, scroll-wheel inventory interactions
- **Better Statistics Screen** — completely overhauled stats page
- **Raised** — moves the hotbar up from the screen edge
- **Camera Utils** — custom third-person distance and camera controls
- **Better F1 Reborn** — fine-grained control over what F1 hides

---

> Items marked `[RP]` are resource packs, not mods. Install them in your resource pack folder and enable them in-game via the Resource Packs menu or Resourcify.

---

## Notes

All mods and resource packs in this pack have been manually tested together for compatibility. If you run into any issues, leave a comment, and I'll look into it.

This pack was put together for a YouTube video — if you want to see everything in action and understand what each piece does, check the video linked on my channel.
